title: Figure 3.5: Dipole Magnetic Field Plot and Layout of DaIEC Experimental Devices
description: Panel (a) is a blue field-line plot of a dipole magnetic field around a central bar magnet. Panel (b) is a 3D rendering of the experiment layout inside a spherical vessel with red outline, showing upper and lower hemispherical grids and a blue central dipole coil, with dimensions labeled '10cm', '30cm' and 'distance = 15 cm'. Caption reads 'Figure 3.5. (a) Dipole Magnetic Field and (b) Layout of Devices'.
